label: Mid-original-phase (t=4-5) step in sequences starting with 2, after a recent 3 or on input e
explanation: Sparse conjunctive feature. It fires almost only in the original phase (97% of mass) at steps 3-6, mostly t=4-5, in sequences whose first token is the digit 2 (83% of mass). The strongest activations come on input e right after a 3 (e.g. 2 o 0 3 [e]), and more generally when a 3 is one or two steps back. Sequences with more digits fire more. Magnitude is highest with e plus a preceding 3 at t=4. It never fires in the copy phase, at t<3 or t>=8, or when the sequence has no digits; it fires only weakly at the delimiter. Many 2-initial sequences at t=4-5 without e/3 still give weak activations, and some 2...3 contexts do not fire, so both precision and recall are only moderate.
